coordinate_system.orientation_notes: X follows the overall arm span, Y follows the through-slot machining direction, and Z is transverse to the arms in the top-view plane. The section_aa and top_view coordinate notes establish this convention. The side_view A-A arrows described along -X conflict with section_aa's reported Z cut normal; that marker is not used to infer correspondence between the side-view circular feature and the external shoulders.

relationships.detail: Both arm top surfaces have parallelism controls relative to datum A.
The arm parallelism controls reference datum A.
The left slot position control references datum A as the primary datum.
The left slot position control references the right slot boundary as datum B at MMC.
The position control on the right slot establishing datum B references datum A.
The top view specifies a basic center-to-center separation along X between the left slot and the right datum-B slot.
The left elongated slot passes through the left member of the opposing-arm feature.
The right elongated slot passes through the right member of the opposing-arm feature.
The stepped shoulders join both sides of the central body through the described blend fillets.
The bond-preparation zone occupies the lower transition and flank surfaces of the central protrusion.

datums.description: Two angled surfaces with 90° included angle on the central protrusion
Boundary feature of size of the right elongated hole/slot

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: The slot position controls establish A as the primary datum. The left slot additionally references B as the secondary datum at MMC. The right slot establishes datum B and is itself position-controlled relative to A. No tertiary datum is defined.

feature_graph.part_notes: Scale: 1:1. General tolerance: ASME Y14.5-2009. Projection: third angle. Heat treatment: none specified. Coating: PHOSPHATE COAT PER PS-119.0. General notes: TOLERANCE: METAL THICKNESS VARIATION ±30% ALLOWABLE IN FORMED AREAS. FINISH: PHOSPHATE COAT PER PS-119.0. DEBURR: BREAK ALL SHARP EDGES 0.5 MAX.. Applicability table specifies process 'PS-135.22 *' for BP00B369211.

assumptions.text: Grouped section_aa:F1 with top_view:F1 using Signal 5: both are part-body observations of the same overall arm-to-arm extent, with matching nominal lengths. Selected section_aa:F1 as canonical because it explicitly identifies the axial extent in the section view; neither observation is flagged as truncated.

Retained side_view:F1 as an unresolved singleton rather than merging it with section_aa:F4. The A-A marker identifies a central cutting plane but does not uniquely identify a matching section feature, and the internal-bore interpretation conflicts with the external-shoulder interpretation. Equal nominal diameters alone do not establish identity.
Kept top_view:F2 and top_view:F3 as distinct singleton slots despite identical sizes because they have distinct positions and datum roles; only the right slot establishes datum B.

Retained section_aa:F2 and section_aa:F4 as their existing multi-instance observations. No other section separately models their individual arm or shoulder instances, so no aggregate_refs treatment is applied.

Selected Y as the primary machining axis from the explicitly identified through-slot access directions. Used the mutually consistent top_view and section_aa world-axis convention without resolving the conflicting side_view cutting-arrow orientation.

The 2X Ø42.00 callout identifies the external stepped shoulders shown in Section A-A, which correspond to the toleranced Ø42.13/41.87 outer diameters on either side of the central body rather than internal bores.
The finished width of the opposing arms along Z is 21.62 to 22.38 mm (nominal 22.00 mm), as specified by the 2X 22.38 / 21.62 dimension callout.
The note referenced by the asterisk specifies surface preparation for adhesive bonding across the conical feature bounded by the chain-double-dashed line between the adjacent R 2.50 fillets.

The specified Z-direction extent of the datum-A protrusion is assumed to be 70.92 mm based on the Ø 70.92 O/R vertical/diametrical callout, with the corresponding horizontal axial extent specified as 60.00 mm.
